# THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt from these files; tools\check_layout.ps1 checks them. Keys: docs/CODING_MODEL.md "외부 라이브러리 두기".
name miniaudio
version 0.11.25+1df46ae (upstream fix for CVE-2026-32837, WAV BEXT out-of-bounds read)
license MIT-0
licenseFile LICENSE
source https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio
usedIn engine (audio runtime third_party/mkaudio)
inGame yes
kept miniaudio.h
why audio devices on every target platform (WASAPI, CoreAudio, ALSA/PulseAudio, AAudio, Web Audio), node graph, 3D attenuation, WAV decoding and streaming in one file. The engine's sound events, voice management and buses (mealkit/audio) are built on it. SDL3 was measured instead and not used (+1.6-1.9 MB exe, docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-18).
